title: KYA-OS Needs-Authorization Error
description: Error returned when a tool call requires user authorization. The response is itself signed (detached JWS in _meta) so the client can verify the authorizationUrl before trusting it; the client resumes the flow with resumeToken after the user grants authority (SPEC §9.2).

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what authorization is required.

authorizationUrl.description: URL where the user grants authorization. Bound by the response proof's responseHash to detect substitution.

resumeToken.description: Opaque token used to resume the flow after authorization is granted.

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when resumeToken expires.

context.description: Optional implementation-specific context carried with the challenge.

AuthorizationDisplay.description: Optional presentation hints for rendering the authorization prompt.

title.description: Short title for the authorization prompt.

authorizationCode.description: Short human-enterable code, when 'code' presentation is offered.

qrUrl.description: URL to encode as a QR code, when 'qr' presentation is offered.

examples.message: Authorization required to send email on the user's behalf.
